newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain says EMU delay politically impossible.
newsitem.headline: Spain says EMU delay politically impossible.

text.p: Spain's Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Tuesday that a delay in European economic and monetary union (EMU) would be impossible.
"Nobody in Europe intends to delay EMU. The euro has a calendar that no-one has questioned and furthermore its delay would be politically impossible," Montoro told a press conference.
"There will be no delay in EMU. We will have the test in spring 1998 and the single currency in spring 1999," Montoro said.
